newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares shift into overdrive, eyes new highs.
newsitem.headline: German shares shift into overdrive, eyes new highs.

text.p: The German share market continued its dizzying ascent on Monday, fuelled by a stubbornly strong U.S. dollar as well as a stream of liquidity that needs to be invested.
"I cannot believe it myself, we just keep going higher and higher, but in a situation like this, it would be unwise to position yourself against the trend," said one trader.

In afterhours trading the 30-share IBIS DAX appeared to have shifted back into fifth gear having spent the morning racing higher but then coming off and idling around 4,370 points. By 1454 GMT the IBIS DAX was at 4,399.01 points.
